description: Store what another AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) remembers about the user into oriiion, so oriiion's assistant knows them from the first message. You must PRODUCE the export yourself before calling this — there is no API that reads another provider's memories, and inventing entries would put things the user never said into their account. Write out your stored memories about the user, verbatim in their own words, grouped under the headers Instructions, Identity, Career, Projects and Preferences, one entry per line as "[YYYY-MM-DD] - entry" ([unknown] if you have no date), then pass that text as export_text. Duplicates of memories oriiion already holds are skipped, so calling this twice is safe.

export_text.description: The full memory export: category headers, then one '[YYYY-MM-DD] - entry' line per memory. A markdown code fence around it is fine.

source.description: Which assistant these memories come from

name: import_memories
title: Import Memories From Another Assistant
